scheme: The general P1 thematic sequence (Our Transport; Things We Make; Our Environment; Peace and Security) is separate from the NCDC IRE subject-specific sequence. Theme labels indicate school term timing only, not IRE lesson content.

NCDC IRE Theme 12 includes cleanliness of clothes, worship places, the environment, and Prophet Muhammad's journey to Syria. Only two 40-minute lessons fit the final week; remaining details need additional sourced sessions.
The final period introduces the Syria journey with a brief term review; a complete stand-alone end-of-term assessment paper requires an additional assessment period selected by Ledgerly.
